summary: Simone Brunozzi, based in San Francisco, technology evangelist at Amazon Web Services, former barista, experienced public speaker with over 500 presentations, Italian native from Umbria, strong advocate for effective teaching methods, passionate about beekeeping, frequent traveler with 500 flights in five years, critical of food quality in San Francisco compared to Italy, engaged in discussions about transportation technology, and has a family structure that includes a father he values.
